articles.title: Sports betting should be regulated as a financial product, not gambling, aspiring prediction market provider says
articles.snippet: Novig CEO Jacob Fortinsky said his company will transition to a federal Designated Contract Market framework this summer to launch in all 50 states, while 57 Maiden's Adam Mastrelli said he was banned from two major sportsbooks within two months for being “sharp."

articles.title: Bitcoin holds $80K into weekly close as traders say BTC price dip not yet over
articles.snippet: Bitcoin avoided a weekend drop as $80,000 stayed in place, but traders saw BTC price action dipping below before continuing higher.

articles.title: Santiment flags risk as crypto bullish talk spikes while BTC holds $80K
articles.snippet: The increase in bullish versus bearish crypto commentary on social media has Santiment warning that the recent crypto market rally may be short-lived.

articles.title: Strategy CEO Phong Le says company will sell BTC only in specific cases
articles.snippet: Strategy's Bitcoin sales will not move the markets, despite it owning more than 4% of the digital currency's maximum supply, Le said.

articles.title: US Senator questions Mark Zuckerberg on Meta’s stablecoin plans
articles.snippet: Elizabeth Warren asked the Meta CEO to provide details on a stablecoin integration to the platform, a week after a small rollout to creators in Colombia and the Philippines.
